root_cause.text: The function `get_meter_levels_from_urb()` in the Tascam US-16x08 mixer driver uses an unvalidated channel index derived directly from a device-supplied meter packet to write into fixed-size arrays (`meter_level`, `comp_level`, `master_level`), enabling out-of-bounds memory accesses when the index is negative or exceeds the array bounds.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a local `ch` variable computed as `MUB2(meter_urb, s) - 1` and then checks `if (ch < 0) return;` before any access, and further guards `meter_level`/`comp_level` writes with `if (ch < SND_US16X08_MAX_CHANNELS)` and `master_level` writes with `if (ch < ARRAY_SIZE(store->master_level))`. The commit message explicitly states the driver “derives the channel index directly … without validating the range,” leading to writes past the end of the arrays.
